# Running in hot weather

A long run at the weekend builds endurance; keep it slow and steady. Increase total distance by about ten percent per week and take a lighter week every month. Track shoe mileage and replace them around six to eight hundred kilometres. In hot weather slow down by pace, not by effort, and drink before you feel thirsty. Most weekly mileage should be easy enough to hold a conversation.
